title: UPDATE: Zeta Acquires Digital Audience 1 Day After Senso to Link AI Discovery
summary:
The marketing technology firm is merging identity-based activation services with generative search tools to map the consumer journey from a bot's answer to a conversion. Zeta Global announced the acquisition of Digital Audience on October 6, just one day after it agreed to buy AI engineering firm Senso. By combining these assets, Zeta aims to link the moment a brand is discovered in a large language model to the ability to recognize that customer and measure the resulting business action.

Senso, a Y Combinator-backed firm, connects enterprise data with frontier platforms including Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI Overviews. Its technology powers Zeta's Generative Engine Optimization tool, which allows companies to track their visibility in AI-generated answers. Financial terms for the deals were not disclosed, and Zeta is expected to make further announcements at its Zeta Live event on October 8.

We’ve entered into an agreement to acquire @GoSenso, an AI engineering company that will strengthen Zeta’s connections to the world’s leading frontier models.

Senso’s technology already helps power Zeta’s Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) offering, helping brands understand how they appear in AI-generated answers—and who those answers reach.

Senso will bring more AI engineering talent and additional technology to help Zeta improve how brands appear across leading AI platforms and connect those insights to customer intelligence, marketing action, and measurable business results.

We look forward to welcoming Saroop Bharwani and the @GoSenso team to Zeta when the acquisition closes.

And we’re saving our Zeta Live announcements for October 8. Stay tuned for more.
